name: mcp-wikibooks-cookbook
description: MCP server for the Wikibooks Cookbook. Search recipes, read ingredients and steps, and rescale quantities without ending up with 2.4 eggs. No API key required.
long_description:
Search the Cookbook on the English Wikibooks, read a page's ingredients, equipment and steps, browse by cuisine, kind of dish or main ingredient, and rescale an ingredient list to the number of servings you actually want. No API key, no account.

The arithmetic is the part worth having. A countable thing lands where a kitchen can follow it, an egg on a whole one and a clove of garlic on a half. A small measurement moves to a smaller unit before it is rounded, so it never disappears. A sealed packet is never cut in two. An approximate measure such as a pinch is multiplied as pinches rather than converted. Both figures on a line that publishes two are scaled together. Anything that cannot be multiplied comes back flagged instead of multiplied.

Cookbook pages are published under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0, and every recipe carries its licence and its page address so it can be credited and shared alike.

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Find a Cookbook page by dish name or by an ingredient it uses.

query.description: A dish, such as 'carbonara', or an ingredient, such as 'guanciale'.

search.description: 'text' reads the whole page; 'title' matches the page name only.

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Read one page: ingredients, equipment, steps and yield, optionally rescaled.

id.description: Page key from a search, such as 'Cookbook:Spaghetti_alla_Carbonara'.

servings.description: Rescale the ingredients to this many servings.

tools.name: scale_ingredients
tools.description: Rescale any English ingredient list, without contacting a website.

ingredients.description: Ingredient lines, for example ['450 g (1 pound) spaghetti', '5 egg yolks', 'Salt'].

factor.description: Multiplier to apply. Use this or the from/to pair.

from_servings.description: How many servings the list is written for.

tools.name: list_recipes
tools.description: Browse by cuisine, kind of dish or main ingredient.

cuisine.description: A cuisine or a country, such as 'Italian' or 'Thai'.

dish_type.description: A kind of dish, such as 'soup', 'dessert' or 'bread'.

main_ingredient.description: The ingredient a recipe is built on, such as 'chicken' or 'lentils'.
